description: Mortgage lending in a place — how many applications were originated, denied or withdrawn in a county or state in a given year, with dollar volume, from the federal HMDA register. Break the answer down by applicant race, ethnicity, sex, loan purpose or loan type to see how outcomes differ across groups, which is the fair-lending question this data exists to make answerable. Covers 2018-2025.

action.description: Optional outcome filter: originated | approved_not_accepted | denied | withdrawn | incomplete | purchased. Omit to see every outcome side by side.

breakdown.description: Optional dimension to split by: race | ethnicity | sex | loan_purpose | loan_type.

county.description: 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. "11001" for the District of Columbia.

state.description: Two-letter state, e.g. "TX". Give a county OR a state.

year.description: Filing year, 2018-2025. Defaults to the most recent published.

name: hmda_geography_activity
title: Hmda Geography Activity
